title: One-tape action reader soundness
statement: For every natural number $n$, bit string $x$, action $a$ of a one-work-tape binary machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and bit string $r$, if reading $x$ as an action with one work tape and parameter $n$ succeeds with result $(a,r)$, then $x$ is the serialization of $a$ followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action with one work tape, binary symbols, and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
the action reader with one work tape and parameter $n$ succeeds on $x$ with result $(a,r)$
